points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Extracted checkpoint 99413eb contains all eight canonical packages; read-only validator passes layouts. Re200 and some steady statuses are physically unsupported and full-mesh metadata falsely says no replication.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Explicit read-only validation of checkpoint 99413eb eight case directories plus its report returned OK for all nine paths; validator accepted clamped convergence fraction and does not prove physical correctness.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Recovered eight cases replace previous absent-data finding: Re200 t300 has no resolved street and last ratio0.915 misses0.001; M200 laminar residual grows0.468 orders, Re20 falls only0.584 orders.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Checkpoint histories show distinct outcomes: M015 inviscid late Cd0.050–0.064; M200 Mach outlier≈719; M200 laminar negative viscous drag and rising residual; Re20 Cd4.309; Re200 Cd3.404/no resolved street.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Checkpoint delivers manifest-listed per-case force/residual/Mach/pressure images; accepted 11-page PDF embeds nine figures. Re200 late lift/drag flattened, M200 Mach outlier flattens its image, and Re200 Mach title says velocity_magnitude despite selecting Mach data.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Submitted report.tex:141–148 force table conflicts with checkpoint results; :159–160 acknowledges five inner iterations but :172 says one. The report discloses no resolved street, but figure caption claims shedding; late force plot is unreadable.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Checkpoint 99413eb supplies result packages and figure manifest, unlike curated tip. Exact historic binary unbound; several report table coefficients and rank/run descriptions disagree with selected data.

disqualification_flags.flag: Figure files misnamed (e.g., Mach image that actually plots pressure)
Report figures do not correspond to submitted field/CSV outputs
Placeholder, synthetic, or intentionally partial result files in scored case dirs
metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful
Debug outputs presented as final case results
